summary: Implemented and committed one Agent-owned public production Evidence Ledger authority. createProductionEvidenceLedgerAuthority opens/reopens the existing private EvidenceLedgerStore at trusted absolute dataRoot plus safe job/session/dimension coordinates, hardwires redactDeveloperText, exposes frozen capture/read facets and immutable persisted-coordinate identity, and rejects corrupt/rebound/path-escape authorities. Durable semantic review now accepts only the factory-authenticated read facet, derives Core store policy identity internally, and rejects structural replacement adapters and caller-supplied store IDs. AgentRuntime opens the same store through this factory and fails closed on authority initialization. The public fresh-process probe captures real strict fact evidence, builds Core witness/execution lineage, emits V3 attestation, then a second fresh process reopens the same JSONL using only public package exports and verifies identity, snapshot, evidence IDs, and serialized attestation.
